row.title: Graph AI layer on DATAGRAPH-1 tables
row.body: KGRAPH-AI-1: embeddings, extracted relations, community summaries and a cost probe (/api/graph/ai) run on DATAGRAPH-1's tables. PR 2166 was closed as a duplicate of PR 2158 because it reused kg_nodes/kg_edges with a different schema.
